name: Link
summary: Goes to another page or place; inline in text or standing alone.

anatomy.description: Underlined, in link.default; on hover the underline thickens and the colour stays at text contrast (link.hover).
A drawn arrow after links that leave the site, out of the accessible name.

variants.description: Leaves the site: the arrow mark.

cues.hover: A thicker underline; link.hover keeps text contrast, so hover is never a contrast drop.

a11y.name: Its text, meaningful out of context.
notes: Isolated with dir=auto so an address keeps its direction in a right-to-left sentence.

platforms.flutter: Text with a TapGestureRecognizer in a Link widget
